description.html: Small toilets save more space, a modern and compact design. This small toilet is designed for very small spaces, but the compact toilet looks perfect in every modern bathroom. This one-piece skirted toilet not only hides the curved sewage pipe but also enhances the elegant appearance of the toilet; by eliminating the gap between the tank and bowl, it eliminates the hiding places for dirt and debris, making it easy to clean. The seat cover of this dual-flush round one-piece universal height skirt toilet closes quietly without making any noise. The dual-flush toilet flushes a powerful 1.1/1.6 GPF, which is very reliable and also saves water. This version of the toilet comes with a very smooth glaze that prevents particles from sticking to the ceramic. This feature, combined with the high efficiency flush, helps reduce the frequency of toilet cleaning, minimizing the use of water, harsh chemicals, and the time required for cleaning.
